g.text: Evidence remains visible after an earlier exclusion

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #617481

g.text: Independent counts overlap. A gene can have evidence from bulk, clusters, immune cells and protein simultaneously.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #617481

g.text: Coverage and nomination failures alone never establish Unsafe. Reliable protein and the upper linked RNA thresholds can establish a research exclusion.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #617481

g.text: The companion table also reports how many categories change if each individual layer is removed.
